### Highlights

- Added English and Traditional Chinese localization with system-language detection and a persistent language selector in the sidebar.
- Improved macOS external-display matching by excluding built-in displays and matching online displays by EDID vendor, product, and serial identity.

### Improved

- DisplayMux now wakes the target host first and automatically selects the available network or local DDC/CI switching path.
- Confirmation and progress messages use in-app dialogs for a more consistent experience.

### Known limitations

- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed but not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may require manual approval.
- Some MST, DisplayLink, and Silicon Motion docks do not expose DDC/CI. Software cannot restore DDC commands that the dock chipset does not forward.
